data.name: ACE COMBAT™ 7: SKIES UNKNOWN
data.detailed_description:
ACE COMBAT™ 7: SKIES UNKNOWN - TOP GUN: Maverick Ultimate Edition


Contém o jogo ACE COMBAT™ 7: SKIES UNKNOWN, o conjunto de aeronaves TOP GUN: Maverick Aircaft Set e o passe de temporada.


ACE COMBAT™ 7: SKIES UNKNOWN - TOP GUN: Maverick Edition


Contém o jogo ACE COMBAT™ 7: SKIES UNKNOWN e o conjunto de aeronaves TOP GUN: Maverick Aircaft Set.


Acerca do jogo

Prepara-te para voar pelos céus! ACE COMBAT 7: SKIES UNKNOWN põe-te no cockpit das aeronaves mais avançadas alguma vez desenvolvidas, para uma experiência de voo e tiros brava e incomparável. Abate o inimigo para escapares com vida.

— TRAVA COMBATES AÉREOS INTENSOS EM AERONAVES REAIS


As batalhas em ACE COMBAT 7: SKIES UNKNOWN combinam manobrabilidade realista, opções extensas de aeronaves e velocidade alucinante para uma adrenalina que qualquer pessoa pode apreciar. Sejas um piloto inexperiente ou um ás da aviação, voar pelos céus numa aeronave à tua escolha é uma alegria tremenda.
A vasta gama de aeronaves de última geração e as armas e tecnologia do futuro tornam ACE COMBAT 7: SKIES UNKNOWN a experiência mais realista possível. Cada aeronave pode ser personalizada com uma vastidão de peças e armamento.
Rasgar o céu azul com 360 graus de manobrabilidade em perseguição do inimigo é uma emoção inesquecível. Vai atrás dos teus alvos e lança ataques em terra, no mar e no ar para dominar os céus!

— JUNTA-TE AOS ASES DE STRANGEREAL


Participa na série ACE COMBAT que tem lugar nas terras e céus fictícios de Strangereal. Com o acelerar de uma guerra entre nações rivais, a tecnologia colide com os valores humanos sob a forma de enormes aeronaves não tripuladas que ameaçam alterar o equilíbrio do poder. A tua história é uma luta pela sobrevivência nos confins do céu. Assume o controlo de aeronaves reais para voar em busca de um futuro melhor e provar que um ás da aviação é insubstituível.

— VOA NO PALCO DINÂMICO DO CÉU


O mundo é diferente visto das nuvens. A velocidades estonteantes, a tua aeronave consegue furar tempestades e perder-se no brilho ofuscante do Sol. As condições atmosféricas podem mudar rapidamente, e os pilotos habilidosos podem usá-las para virar a maré de uma batalha complicada. Até o teu HUD e instrumentos podem ser afetados pelo clima, obrigando-te a estar sempre alerta. Se tiveres essas condições em conta nos teus voos, o vasto céu fotorrealista de Strangereal estará à tua mercê.

— ENCONTRA O TEU ESQUADRÃO NO MODO MULTIJOGADOR


Forma uma equipa e entra em ação no modo Battle Royal ou Death Match. Luta em união contra equipas de todo o mundo para o teu esquadrão ser o melhor!

reviews.review:
[u][b]-Quick Review-[/b][/u]
Ace Combat 04: Shattered skies is the first and only other Ace Combat game I’ve played. Today that has been rectified as I have now played Ace Combat 7: Skies Unknown… So many memories came rushing back while playing, namely: I was reminded why I thought as a high schooler I might be cut out for being a fighter pilot after playing Ace Combat 04… The game makes you feel AWESOME, like you could just jump into a jet and do a barrel roll!

[u][b]Review Video:[/b][/u]
If you don't like reading, or are curious about watching gameplay check out my video here:
https://youtu.be/bE1uDW3-hgc

[u][b]-Detailed breakdown review-[/b][/u]
[b]Story:[/b] In my own words and without spoiling the story… You play as our silent protagonist “Trigger”. An Osean fighter pilot, who gets moved around from unit to unit in response to the conflict between the Osea and Erusea.
However, the story narrative is primarily told from the perspective of three different characters: “The scrap pilot girl”, “Princess peach wanna be”, and “Definitely-not-Evil scientist man”. In between dog flighting as Trigger you’ll get tidbits of the story from these three other characters to paint the picture of the conflict between Osea and Erusea and the consequences from Triggers various missions.
The overall story for Ace Combat 7: Skies Unknown can be summarized as: tension between Osea and Erusea erupt into warfare, Erusea is using drones as dogfighters, oh no they made a drone mother ship super weapon and they’re using flight data from a Veteran “ungodly good pilot” to strengthen their drones’ capabilities.
There were a number of fun story telling dodges and twists, my favorite one that I dare not spoil… lead to a bit of a “redemption arc” we’ll say. The tone of the voice of your briefings and debriefings made me audibly laugh out loud at the middle part of the game. I’ll always remember Ace Combat 7’s story because of “Spare Squadron”, if you play the game you’ll know what I’m talking about.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3784225787

[b]Gameplay:[/b] I always wondered why Ace Combat resonated so well with me, while I struggled to play proper flight simulators… turns out that difference was intentional since Ace Combat mixes some realistic flight simulator elements but mixes in some fast-paced arcade action!
I played with an xbox controller, but you can translate the controls to whatever console or device you play on. Controls are pretty standard for an arcade flight simulator game, throttle and break with the right and left triggers to speed up and slow down. Right and left bumpers are your Yaw rudder controls. Left thumb stick (AKA Analog stick) controls your pitch and nose up or down. Fire missile, change to special weapon, change target, and switch camera view. Lastly you have your… what I insist on calling the PlayStation “Select” button which will toggle between the different Radar or mini map settings.
You’ll notice I said nothing about the right thumbstick. I didn’t use it. It’s to LOOK around… I dunno what kind of MLG gamers are out there craning their necks while dog fighting in Ace Combat games… but it wasn’t me. That’s for sure.
My plane of existence is forward HUD view on all flight simulators. No looking right, left, up or down for me no sir! I also will leave the cockpit view on when I’m roleplaying… toggle it off when I’m in focus mode… and play games in third person when I’m looking for atmospheric camera angles.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3784874908

[b]Conclusion:[/b] In conclusion, I really enjoyed returning to the Ace Combat Franchise! …distance makes the heart grow fonder, and I hadn’t played Ace Combat 04 on the PS2 since sometime in 2007 or something.
Ace Combat 7 took me 13 hours to complete the main game, and then after another 20 something hours until I decided I had done enough extra stuff for now, but I’m sure I’ll come back at some point to get more achievements. I’m just tired from running the campaign over and over on different difficulties.
The story was interesting… of course the whole turn we took with “Spare Squadron” was my favorite… the 3d animated cutscenes typically felt SUPER exaggerated and the characters seemed lifeless and emotionless… sometimes it felt like I was watching a clothing brand commercial instead of a cutscene for Ace Combat 7.
The gameplay was EXACTLY what the doctor ordered, I wanted to buzz around feeling like God’s gift to the skies, and that’s what I got. Again, Ace Combat games will definitely appeal to anyone who likes arcade aircraft combat flight simulator nerds, but it can appeal to a wider demographic… chances are if you like what you’ve seen or heard about Ace Combat, you might want to consider picking it up!
